line: From the globe down into the strait a fifth of the world's oil squeezes through: two lanes, a cut through the sea floor, and pipelines that can carry only a fraction of it around.
line_cn: 从地球一路落进这道海峡：世界约五分之一的石油挤过两条航道，剖开看水下有多深，再看绕行的管道只能分走多少。

camera.move: Dive and level out (log distance, pitch from ~80° to ~45°)
camera.serves: a region to its key point
a width, a name, a verdict

camera.move: Orbit + crane down to the cut
Low tracking shot along a line
camera.serves: a lane, a river, a road

camera.move: Big pull-out over the whole region

transitions: Transitions: dissolves through the atmosphere (globe ↔ map, with the cameras matched), the cut that opens the ground, one rhythmic hard cut at most, everything else continuous.
labels: A condensed grotesk for everything Latin (e.g. Barlow Condensed, OFL): country names 600 at ~30 px with wide tracking (≈ 0.3 em); sea names 500 at ~21 px, pale blue; island and port names 15 px; data numbers 600 at 70–96 px with a small unit and a smaller source line beside or under them. A CJK sans (e.g. Noto Sans SC, OFL, subset to the characters used) for Chinese, ≥ 34 px.
Labels sit on the map where the thing is, and fade with the camera's height: a far set (countries, seas) hands over to a near set (islands, ports). A label the frame would cut fades out instead.
Measurements are drawn, then labelled: a line grows from its middle to both ends, end ticks snap on, then the label appears beside the line, never on the data.

A cross-section is labelled like an engineering drawing: a small caption and a headline in the upper left, the exaggeration factors under them, a depth scale on the side, dashed soundings from the surface to the floor with their value.
motion: The camera never stops dead: distance interpolates in log space, keys are monotone cubic, holds keep a slow drift.

The glowing layer arrives by being drawn: lines grow from their source, a lane ignites with a bright head running along its real course, pulses flow in the direction of travel, pillars grow slab by slab on the beat.
Depth of field, fog and bloom change continuously with height; nothing pops.
Traffic moves at a time-lapse speed that reads (a few km per film second), all in its lanes.

native_moves.name: The dive from orbit
native_moves.does: One push from the globe into the place, a dissolve through the atmosphere where the globe and the map share one camera.
native_moves.fits: any place that matters to the world; a city in a country; a reef in an ocean.

native_moves.name: Flows converge
native_moves.does: Points light up and their routes grow and pour into one line.
native_moves.fits: commuters into a city centre; tributaries into a river; roads into a pass.

native_moves.name: A line ignites along its true course
native_moves.does: A bright head runs along the real geometry and leaves the line, its boundaries and its traffic behind.
native_moves.fits: a rail line; a border; a pipeline; a migration route.

native_moves.name: Cut the map open
native_moves.does: Sweep away one side of the terrain along a line and show the profile underneath.
native_moves.fits: the depth of a lake; a river valley; a tunnel under a mountain; an aquifer.

native_moves.name: Fly the line
native_moves.does: A low tracking shot along it, a ruler across it.
native_moves.fits: a bridge's span; a canal; a runway; a front line.

native_moves.name: Quantities on the ground
native_moves.does: A pillar grows where the quantity belongs, and its alternatives grow beside it on the same scale.
native_moves.fits: a river's yearly discharge; a dam's output; harvests by region.

native_moves.name: Back to the world
native_moves.does: Pull out to the globe, the data layer still glowing.
native_moves.fits: where things go next; who depends on this place.

score.note: low plucked pulse, cello spiccato, bowed vibraphone, frame drum on downbeats
